payload.text: After the WP13 cutover, candidates under hv's simpler-or-easier rule, none in commit 3 (cc, critic-rust's second read of WP11 commit 3): (a) unify the three picture rules, the engine's, pplr_pictures' and the index's, which differ as their legacy scripts did; that changes behaviour on real data, so it is a divergence and needs hv's ruling (a comment on tree::PICTURES records the difference); (b) Pair.how's vocabulary as an enum, behaviour-preserving. Left as is by vc's ruling: an option taken as another's value (sync --link --group --apply) falls to a dry run, which is safe.
